changelog:
edu-homework-grader 1.0.0

- Initial release: Automated K-12 homework grading for Chinese, Math, English, Physics, and Chemistry.
- Supports both objective (strict matching) and subjective (rubric-based, partial credit) items, including essays, derivations, and translations.
- Generates detailed per-student score sheets with feedback, class statistics, knowledge-point heatmaps, and improvement suggestions.
- Accepts text, images (with OCR), PDFs, and batch formats.
- Transparent, auditable rubrics with detailed error analysis and compliance/safety features included.
